verdict.rationale: BigCommerce's developer docs describe building custom apps/integrations, REST/GraphQL APIs, Stencil theme scaffolding, and the Catalyst (Next.js) headless SDK, plus a marketplace path for 'single-click apps' — covering SDKs, scaffolding, and a distribution channel. However, there's no detailed documentation of an app review/approval process, and hands-on community feedback describes the Stencil theming system as inconsistent and hard to work with, and API access as unreliable under load, undercutting the tooling experience. Missing for 10: explicit app-review/certification process docs, independent corroboration of smooth SDK/scaffolding usage, and resolution of cited API reliability/theme complexity complaints.
